concerns.text: The idea requires ingestion of the CMIP6 v3.2 solar forcing dataset as an independent baseline for comparison (see Idea.md ‘Related work’ and ‘Expected results’). The specification’s functional requirements (FR-001‑FR-009) never mention acquiring, validating, or using CMIP6 data, leaving the contract `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` for a TSI dataset unexercised.

The idea’s edge‑case handling calls for a separate “facular proxy” term when GSN ≈ 0 but TSI remains non‑zero (see Idea.md ‘Edge Cases’). The specification only provides a low‑activity proxy for long gaps (FR‑002) and does not require a facular proxy component, so the model could incorrectly predict TSI = 0 for such cycles.
